name: Snowflake
desc: Data warehouse built for the cloud

actions.name: runQuery
actions.description: Execute a SQL query against your Snowflake database and return the results as rows.

actions.name: runMultipleQueries
actions.description: Execute multiple SQL statements in sequence against your Snowflake database. Optionally wrap them in a transaction so all changes are rolled back if any statement fails.

actions.name: insert-row
actions.description: Insert a row into a table.

actions.name: update_row
actions.description: Update one or more rows in a Snowflake table that match a WHERE condition.

actions.name: delete_row
actions.description: Delete one or more rows from a Snowflake table that match a WHERE condition.

actions.name: upsert_row
actions.description: Insert a new row or update an existing one if a row with the same match column value already exists (MERGE INTO).

actions.name: insert_multiple_rows
actions.description: Insert multiple rows into a Snowflake table in a single operation.

actions.name: get_row_by_id
actions.description: Retrieve a single row from a Snowflake table by matching a column value.

actions.name: search_rows
actions.description: Search for rows in a Snowflake table using an optional WHERE condition, ordering, and row limit.

actions.name: get_table_schema
actions.description: Retrieve the column definitions (name, data type, nullability, default) for a Snowflake table.

actions.name: list_tables
actions.description: List all tables in a Snowflake schema.

actions.name: execute_stored_procedure
actions.description: Call a stored procedure in Snowflake and return its result.

actions.name: create_dynamic_table
actions.description: Create or replace a Snowflake Dynamic Table that automatically refreshes based on a query. Dynamic Tables are a declarative way to define a table whose content is derived from a query, updated on a schedule.

actions.name: load_data_from_stage
actions.description: Load data into a Snowflake table from a named internal or external stage using COPY INTO.

triggers.name: new_row
triggers.description: Triggers when a new row is inserted into the selected table. Uses a timestamp column you choose to detect rows added since the last check.

triggers.name: new_or_updated_row
triggers.description: Triggers when a row is inserted or updated in the selected table. Uses an "updated at" timestamp column you choose — any row whose timestamp is newer than the last check will fire the trigger.

triggers.name: new_column
triggers.description: Triggers when a new column is added to the selected table. Checked by polling every few minutes.

triggers.name: new_table
triggers.description: Triggers when a new table is created in the selected schema. Checked by polling every few minutes.

triggers.name: new_view
triggers.description: Triggers when a new view is created in the selected schema. Checked by polling every few minutes.
